name: Freight quartermaster
design: Short broad mature female with olive-brown speckled hide, low wide cranium and four stout mandibles, short dreadlocks with leather ties. Dark quilted shoulder wrap, long brown leather front apron over black calf-length tunic, large divided tool belt. Carries a small secured rectangular inventory case by its handle in left hand; right hand resting on belt. Heavy forearm gloves with claw tips.
